levels.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE premium pixel-art garden game tile for a growing dog shelter.
Input images: Image 1 is the completed LEVEL 5 garden in this series: preserve its near-overhead camera, warm pixel-art style, square footprint and precise four-entrance cross geometry. Generate the requested EARLIER upgrade stage, distinctly simpler and with fewer amenities and smaller capacity than that luxurious final reference. Image 2 is a neighboring game area STYLE reference.
Primary request: A beautiful SQUARE garden serving as the central public plaza for happy dogs. Near overhead game camera with just a slight tilt to show depth (about 12 degrees off vertical), axis-aligned square edges, never a rotated diamond. Crisp handcrafted pixel art, rich carefully clustered pixels, clean outlined forms, no blur or photographic/3D-render sheen.
NON-NEGOTIABLE GEOMETRY: Four OPEN entrances, one EXACTLY at the MIDPOINT of each of the TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT and RIGHT sides. A straight vertical golden-sand walking path connects top and bottom. A straight horizontal golden-sand walking path connects left and right. They intersect at the exact center, making a plus sign. Both are about 14% of the garden width. All four entrance gaps must be visibly open and the paths extend to the plot boundary. Preserve exactly this geometry through every upgrade level. Keep the entire cross and center clear and walkable: no fountain, statue, tree, hedge, furniture, gate or arch across any path. Subtle flush paving details are fine.
Composition: complete single square garden, centered, fills roughly 90% of square canvas with even small margins, ALL outer edges visible, four landscaped quadrants around the path cross. In each quadrant preserve generous lawn where dogs can walk. Objects belong entirely within their quadrant. The garden is EMPTY of dogs and people so animated dogs can be overlaid later.
Lighting: bright soft spring daylight, coherent small pixel shadows falling lower-right, inviting and beautifully tended.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA outside the garden, no checkerboard painted into the image, no matte, no scenery, no cast shadow outside the tile.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, titles, level badges, logos, borders around the image, labels or watermark. ONE tile only, not a grid.
LEVEL 1 of 5: the small and simple starter garden. Fresh soft green lawn, neat low hedge edging with the four midpoint gaps, four modest shrubs near the outer corners, a few daisy clusters, one small wooden bench and a single young leafy tree. Mostly open grassy space. Simple compact scale and few objects, but exceptionally polished, welcoming, vibrant and crafted, never neglected or poor. Golden sandy cross paths with a plain empty center.
